source_refs.note: Topic 2.1 with its Tidbit, as printed (PDF 25, printed 20); the text under the heading Computational Thinking is its own lesson.

blocks.text: Computational thinking is a way of thinking to solve problems clearly and logically. It helps us break big problems into smaller and simpler parts. This thinking is not only for computer science students.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Computational thinking is used by scientists, engineers, and even chefs when planning complex tasks.
